timeline.summary: Suraj Estate Developers filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 showing full utilization of ₹293.51 Cr preferential issue proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹98.78 Cr (-27.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹10.75 Cr (-41.2% YoY).
On May 31, 2026, Suraj Estate Developers announced through its subsidiary an MOU to acquire development rights for a Mahim West land parcel for ₹75 Cr with an estimated ₹800 Cr GDV.
Mukesh Gupta (ICSI F6959) submitted the audio recording of Suraj Estate Developers Limited’s Analyst/Investor Conference Call on June 1, 2026, discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 performance.
Mukesh Kumar Gupta (ICSI F6959) announced Suraj Estate Developers Limited’s participation in a virtual analyst/institutional investor meet on June 11, 2026, at 12:00 PM via Choice Broking.
Suraj Estate Developers submitted its annual promoter share encumbrance disclosure for FY26 showing zero pledged shares.
Suraj Estate Developers reported FY26 presales of ₹615 Cr, beating guidance, alongside commercial land acquisitions in Mahim and Prabhadevi.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹170.04 Cr (+17.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹23.05 Cr (-30.3% YoY).
